title: Apple hints at paid limits for Siri AI, heavy users may need to subscribe to iCloud+

content_html:
During the last earnings call under Tim Cook's leadership at Apple, artificial intelligence became a focal point for investors. Apple's management addressed market concerns regarding whether Siri AI could drive demand for iPhone upgrades and the cost pressures from investments in AI infrastructure, and for the first time publicly hinted that Siri AI might adopt a paid model in the future.

Cook stated that the current financial impact of Siri AI remains uncertain, but he revealed that users who frequently use Siri AI may need to subscribe to iCloud+ in the future. Although Apple has previously promoted Siri AI as a free feature within iPhone, iPad, and Mac systems, it relies on cloud computing resources, including Apple's own cloud services and third-party cloud infrastructure. Continuously running large language model queries incurs additional costs.

According to the information, Apple plans to set certain usage limits for free access to Siri AI. Regular users can use it within the limit for free, while heavy users exceeding the limit may need to purchase an iCloud+ plan. Currently, Apple has not disclosed specific usage counts or limit standards, and the final pricing mechanism still needs further confirmation.

In addition to Siri AI, Apple has previously indicated that some Apple Intelligence features will adopt a tiered usage strategy. For example, the "Clean Up" and "Extend" features in the iOS 27 Photos app, as well as the redesigned "Image Playground" app, will have usage limits, with iCloud+ subscribers receiving higher quotas. Additionally, the AI video recording feature in the Family app requires a 2TB iClould plan, and the new Cloud Pro model in the Shortcuts app is only available to higher-tier iClould+ users.

The iOS 27 featuring Siri AI is expected to be released later this year, supporting devices including the iPhone 15 Pro and subsequent models, as well as Mac devices supporting Apple Intelligence. Due to regulatory factors, Siri AI will not be available in the European and Chinese markets in the short term. As the computing costs of AI features continue to rise, Apple is exploring new ways to commercialize AI capabilities through subscription services.

content_html_zh:
在蒂姆·库克领导的苹果公司的上一次财报电话会议上，人工智能成为投资者关注的焦点。 苹果管理层针对市场对 Siri AI 能否带动 iPhone 升级需求以及 AI 基础设施投资带来的成本压力的担忧，首次公开暗示 Siri AI 未来可能会采用付费模式。

库克表示，目前 Siri AI 的财务影响仍不确定，但他透露，经常使用 Siri AI 的用户未来可能需要订阅 iCloud+。 尽管苹果此前将 Siri AI 推广为 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 系统内的免费功能，但它依赖于云计算资源，包括苹果自己的云服务和第三方云基础设施。 持续运行大型语言模型查询会产生额外成本。

信息显示，苹果计划对免费访问 Siri AI 设置一定的使用限制。 普通用户可以在限额内免费使用，而超过限额的重度用户可能需要购买 iCloud+ 套餐。 目前，苹果尚未透露具体的使用次数或限制标准，最终的定价机制仍需进一步确认。

除了Siri AI之外，苹果此前曾表示，部分Apple Intelligence功能将采用分层使用策略。 例如，iOS 27 Photos应用程序中的“清理”和“扩展”功能，以及重新设计的“Image Playground”应用程序将有使用限制，iCloud+订阅者将获得更高的配额。 此外，Family应用程序中的AI视频录制功能需要2TB iClould计划，而Shortcuts应用程序中的新Cloud Pro模型仅适用于更高级别的iClould+用户。

采用 Siri AI 的 iOS 27 预计将于今年晚些时候发布，支持包括 iPhone 15 Pro 及后续机型在内的设备，以及支持 Apple Intelligence 的 Mac 设备。 由于监管因素，Siri AI短期内不会在欧洲和中国市场上市。 随着AI功能的计算成本不断上升，苹果正在探索通过订阅服务将AI功能商业化的新方式。
